info.name: Mega Application API v1.0
info.description:
Generated from swagger/swagger.json. Do not edit this file directly.

Setup after import:
1. Set `host` to your Mega installation URL without a trailing slash.
2. Set `account_id` and `api_access_token` in the collection variables.
3. Open any Application API folder and send a request; authentication is inherited automatically.
4. Configure `platform_api_access_token` only when using Mega Platform APIs.

Mega Public APIs do not inherit authentication. Resource identifiers are also exposed as collection variables for quick reuse.
`Idempotency-Key` is optional and disabled in generated requests. Enable it to use Postman's `{{$guid}}` value or replace it with a fixed key to test an exact replay.

Returns MCP server metadata and the exposed tool catalog.

Executes a JSON-RPC method on the MCP server endpoint.

Mega also provides an opt-in multipart HTTP transport extension for local files. Send the complete JSON-RPC request
in the `payload` part and one or more files as `attachments[]`. Multipart uploads are accepted only for
`tools/call` requests targeting `conversation_message_send`, its legacy alias, or `outbound_messages_create`.
Outbound messages accept one file; conversation messages retain their normal attachment limit. Generic MCP
clients do not automatically support this extension.

The `outbound_messages_create` tool also advertises `_meta["openai/fileParams"]` for ChatGPT's native file
picker. JSON clients can provide exactly one `file` descriptor with a temporary HTTPS `download_url` and
`file_id`, a `file_base64` object, or an existing signed ID. Temporary URLs are downloaded through SafeFetch
with HTTPS-only redirects, SSRF protection, and upload-size validation. Invalid, expired, or byte-less signed
IDs return `422 invalid_attachment` before provider delivery.

## Features
- Schedule messages for future delivery
- Attach up to 15 files
- Use WhatsApp templates
- Set up recurring messages (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly)

## Recurrence Options
Messages can be set to recur automatically:
- **Daily**: Send every N days
- **Weekly**: Send on specific days of the week
- **Monthly**: Send every N months
- **Yearly**: Send every N years

You can limit recurrence by:
- Setting an end date
- Limiting the number of occurrences
- Setting it to never end

Lists account tasks. Account administrators and custom roles with `task_view_all` can read all
account tasks. Standard agents and custom roles with `task_manage` only receive tasks assigned to them or created by
them. Users with `task_reports_view` can read all tasks for report drilldowns. The Tasks feature and its account
integration must both be enabled.

`overdue` is a computed display status for pending or in-progress tasks whose deadline has passed. The `pending` and
`in_progress` filters return only work that is not overdue; use `overdue` for expired work. The date range is applied
only when both `starts_at` and `ends_at` are supplied. Report drilldowns may instead filter the effective scheduled
date (`ends_at`, falling back to `starts_at`) with `scheduled_from` and `scheduled_to` Unix timestamps. Use
`overlaps_from` and `overlaps_to` to return tasks whose time interval intersects a calendar range. Pagination is
opt-in: responses include `meta` only when `page` or `per_page` is supplied.

to 100 occurrences.
